title: Dhavani Kanavugal
desc: An older brother tries to get his five younger sisters married but fails due to their poverty. So, he goes to town for work when an incident completely changes his life.

title: Thedinen Vanthathu
desc: A man and his friend try to save a bag containing a hefty sum, which they hide in an empty house. When they return for the bag, the house is occupied by a girl and her family.

title: June R
desc: June yearns for a mother's love and affection. She helps an old lady who was hurt in an accident and decides adopt her when her own son opts to put her in an old age home.

title: Moovendhar
desc: After marrying a young man from a family known for their volatile temper, a woman finds herself in a quandary when things do not go as she had hoped.
